Iñigo from Saint Francis University (SFU), Hongkong, during the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signing ceremony held on March 10, 2026. It was presented by Prof. Stephen Y. L. Cheung, SBS, JP, President of Saint Francis University (SFU).
